title: Starcross
goal: 400 points: reach the artifact the mass detector found, get inside and learn its secrets
intro: You're playing Starcross, Infocom's 1982 science fiction text adventure, with your Starcross tools. You're a black hole prospector alone on your ship, the Starcross, and your mass detector has just found something. Reach it, get inside, and work out what it is: 400 points is a perfect score. On the ship the ways are port, starboard and out, as the rooms say. The course to a mass comes from the star chart printed with the game: your notes on Starcross have it.
feel: space is huge and strange; a find like this could make your fortune
